description: Updates Cognigy.AI analytics records for a session. Use this to add custom tracking properties to conversation analytics. MUTATING: Set dryRun=false to update.

contactId.description: The contact (user) ID of the conversation

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without updating. Set to false to actually update.

inputId.description: Restrict the update to a single input (message) of the session

properties.description: Analytics fields to set. Editable fields include rating, ratingComment, custom1..custom10, intent, intentScore, slots, state, mode, flowName, localeName, inHandoverRequest, inHandoverConversation, handoverEscalations

sessionId.description: The session ID to update analytics for

name: update_analytics_record
